rows.question: How do I cancel my monthly membership and get a refund?
rows.answer:
Monthly plans can be refunded within 7 days of the charge. Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of the charge. After that period the plan stays active until the end of the paid term.

Source: Refund > Subscription refund (Returns_Policy)

rows.question: If I send back a $80 jacket I no longer want and there is a 15% fee, what do I get?

Calculation: 80*(1-15/100) = 68.00
